'''Assimara Villagers''' are the [[:Category:Assimara_Parasites|Assimara Version]] of Villagers.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns individually, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]] onward, with a spawnweight of 1, once 6 Villagers have been assimilated.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimara Villagers are Backline Ranged units.

* Assimara Villagers fire acid every 5 seconds, firerate increases as its health lowers.
* Assimara Villagers are incapable of melee attack.
* Assimara Villagers will attempt to maintain a certain distance from their enemies to avoid melee.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimara Villager will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Assimara Villagers are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimara Villagers are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On death Assimara Villagers have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimara Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and COTH.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Assimara Villagers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
